description: Imports the 25-input NecessaryClassicalGodRoot theorem once and unpacks its witness n. Its PerfectRootAt clause gives the actual root and NecessaryAt m.ontic w n, which is literally Holds frame V w (box (atom n)) for the existence valuation (necessaryAt_iff_boxExistsAt, Iff.rfl): no bridge premise identifies the route's necessity with the Kripke box. No frame condition is used, so the node holds in the weakest normal modal logic K.
